FALSE
AS bookmarked FROM courses c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.id = #{courseId} AND c.deleted = 0

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.country_id, country.region_name AS country_name, c.title, c.content FROM courses c LEFT JOIN country_categories country ON country.id = c.country_id WHERE c.id = #{courseId} AND c.deleted = 0

SELECT cd.id AS course_destination_id, cd.destination_id AS destination_id, cd.visit_order AS visit_order, COALESCE(dt.name, '이름 없는 여행지') AS destination_name, dt.short_description AS short_description, cc.region_name AS region_name, course.country_id AS country_id, country.region_name AS country_name, COALESCE( ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) AS image_url FROM course_destinations cd JOIN courses course ON course.id = cd.course_id JOIN destinations d ON d.id = cd.destination_id LEFT JOIN destination_translations dt ON dt.destination_id = d.id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' JOIN country_categories cc ON cc.id = d.region_id LEFT JOIN country_categories country ON country.id = course.country_id WHERE cd.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY cd.visit_order ASC, cd.id ASC

SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.title AS course_title, u.nickname AS writer_nickname, c.views AS course_views, COUNT(cd.id) AS destination_count FROM courses c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id JOIN course_destinations cd ON cd.course_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.title, u.nickname, c.views, c.created_at ORDER BY c.views DESC, c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT destination_regions.destination_id, parent.id AS region_id, parent.parent_id, parent.region_name, parent.code, destination_regions.country_code FROM destination_regions JOIN country_categories parent ON parent.id = destination_regions.parent_id ) SELECT destination_id AS destinationId, region_id AS countryId, region_name AS countryName FROM destination_regions WHERE code = country_code AND ( parent_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM country_categories country_child WHERE country_child.parent_id = destination_regions.region_id AND country_child.code LIKE CONCAT(destination_regions.code, '-%') ) )
